<reason>CON won a competitive debate by splitting “identity” from a mandatory continent-wide biometric gate, offering cheaper leakage fixes, and converting PRO’s junta and fallback concessions into a failed trade: irreversible surveillance without enforceable limits or reliable delivery. PRO stayed on the motion and the exclusion-now weighing, but overclaimed that a shared ID is the audit and never closed the enforcement hole.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s Rebuttal 2: AU “will not bind a junta,” so purpose limits are branding; human overrides show the continental biometric layer was never necessary, only dangerous.</best_rebuttal>
